chapter.heading: Amos 8
The Coming Day of Bitter Mourning
chapter.v: This is what the Lord God showed me : behold , a basket of summer fruit .
I will never again pass by them .
and bring the poor of the land to an end ,
and deal deceitfully with false balances ,
and sell the chaff of the wheat ? ”
“ SurelyI will never forget any of their deeds .
and be tossed aboutand sink again , like the Nile of Egypt ? ”
and darken the earth in broad daylight .
and the end of it like a bitter day .
but of hearing the words of the Lord .
but they shall not find it .
they shall fall , and never rise again . ”

footnotes.footnote: 8:2 The Hebrew words for *end* and *summer fruit* sound alike
8:3 Or *The singing women of the palace shall wail*
8:5 An *ephah* was about 3/5 bushel or 22 liters; a *shekel* was about 2/5 ounce or 11 grams
